description: This file defines the 'Recipe' result class for the Coocook schema, including database table mapping, relationships, and utility methods related to recipes.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Recipe
classes.description: A class representing the 'recipes' table with relationships to ingredients, dishes, and tags, and utility methods for duplication and URL formatting.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Creates a copy of the recipe object with a new name, requiring 'name' in arguments.

methods.name: url_name
methods.description: Returns a URL-friendly version of the recipe's name using Coocook::Util::url_name.
